subject: basalt
title: Columnar basalt at Devil's Postpile (GeoDIL number - 555).jpg
description: The geologic formation that is “the Postpile” is a great example of columnar basalt. The columns of hardened lava, with geometric shapes and four to seven sides, make a sort of honeycomb pattern. The columns formed when a basaltic lava flow shrank while cooling.
